text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER DUTY - Routing health flapping detected. High-error fallback loop across regions (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Affected service: routing-service (smart-routing policy). Start: 2025-06-05T14:02:47Z. Severity: P2 -> escalating.

alice-ops: acked. I'm oncall and heading in. seen spike in 502/504s and repeated fallback churn.

ben-sre: i'm seeing inter-region health check toggles in the controller logs. healthcheck status flipping every ~30s for several hosts. Likely policy mis-eval + aggressive fallback.

carla-ml: dropping in — any model variant mismatches? we rolled a new smaller-quantized variant to us-west yesterday. Could fallback be mis-routing to incompatible variant?

ben-sre: good call. logs show model-variant header sometimes missing on fallback requests. fallback routing picks compatible variant by policy, but when header absent it chooses 'latest' which in us-west is the new quantized-3a. Might be a mismatch.

dave-platform: Deploy bot shows a policy change at 13:58 UTC: `smart-routing: prefer-low-cost=false -> true` plus a new fallback variant mapping. I can link: https://deploys.redwood/release/2025-06-05/9843

alice-ops: customer impact? Marta — any reports?

marta-cs: multiple EU customers reporting increased error rates in the last 10m. Affected: two enterprise tenants on dedicated capacity; ~120 req/min, roughly 3x normal failure rate. Tickets created.

alice-ops: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily pause smart-routing policy to stop churn 2) pin routing to stable variant for affected customers 3) increase healthcheck debounce window 4) follow up postmortem. Who can flip policy?

dave-platform: I can roll back the policy toggle via console. Command: `POST /api/admin/policies/smart-routing/toggle` with body `{ "prefer_low_cost": false }`. I'll do gradual.

ben-sre: i'm going to add a temporary circuit-breaker to prevent immediate cross-region fallback loops. patch: `/controllers/routing: add backoff on region-fallback if >3 state-changes/min`. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by dave-platform for rollback (deploy id: 9843-rollback).

alice-ops: while that's rolling, manual pin for impacted tenants: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.redwood/api/customers/tenant-42/pin -d '{"variant":"stable-v2"}'`

carla-ml: I'll inspect the model variant registry. stable-v2 is compatible across regions. quantized-3a had different KV cache layout. That could explain 502s on resume after fallback.

ben-sre: logs excerpt (controller):
```
[14:03:12Z] route-check: host=eu-1 status=HEALTHY
[14:03:12Z] route-check: host=us-east-4 status=DEGRADED -> fallback(us-west-2)
[14:03:43Z] route-check: host=us-west-2 status=HEALTHY -> serve
[14:03:45Z] route-check: host=eu-1 status=UNHEALTHY -> fallback(us-east-4)
[14:04:12Z] route-check: host=us-east-4 status=HEALTHY -> serve
```
This shows 30s oscillation and immediate fallback churn.

alice-ops: dave, what's the ETA on rollback?

dave-platform: rollback finished at 14:05:30Z, config reverted. Circuit-breaker pushed by ben at 14:06:00Z. Monitoring now.

ben-sre: added health debounce: `--health-debounce=45s` on controller for routing evaluation. That's live on the active replicas. Should prevent flipflop.

marta-cs: CS updated customers at 14:07 with rollback note. Some customers reported transient failures but most traffic recovered within ~3m of rollback.

erin-oncall: joining handoff in 15m. Summary for pager: root cause likely policy toggle + new quantized model variant mismatch leading to inconsistent health signals and fallback decisions. Immediate mitigation: policy rollback, pin variants, circuit-breaker, increased debounce.

carla-ml: i'll open a model-registry ticket to flag incompatible quantized variant. Also will add a compatibility check to the routing service to avoid selecting variant with mismatched KV-layout.

ben-sre: triggered synthetic canary tests across regions to validate. current 1m aggregated errors back to baseline ~1.1x. still watching.

alice-ops: action items: [alice-ops] write incident timeline, [carla-ml] add compatibility check, [dave-platform] add safer rollout guard on smart-routing toggles, [ben-sre] adjust alert thresholds to catch bounce patterns.

marta-cs: customers asked for RCA ETA; can we give preliminary ETA by EOD?

alice-ops: yes, we'll have a preliminary RCA by EOD. final by next week.

erin-oncall: taking over oncall at 14:20. I'll continue monitoring for 2 hours then pass to next rotation. If anyone sees re-escalation, ping @erin-oncall.

alice-ops: thanks all. marking incident as mitigated (P2 -> P3). closing pager.

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed by alice-ops at 14:22:00Z. Tags: region-fallback, policy-rollback, model-variant.

carla-ml: note: will schedule a rollout audit to prevent variant incompatibility from being deployed without a routing compatibility flag.

ben-sre: logging for postmortem: `grep fallback controller.log | grep "state-change" > /tmp/fallback-spikes-1741234567.log`

marta-cs: will follow up with customer-facing post-incident note and link to status page.

alice-ops: saved. If anything looks off during the handoff window ping me. Great response, folks. :thumbsup:
